The '''Sarka system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarka/Legends|Sarka]].

==History==
During [[Thrawn campaign]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] [[Raid on Sarka|attacked]] a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] convoy in the system.
